questions.prompt: Explain how the lungs and kidneys both help keep the blood’s composition steady.
questions.modelAnswer: The lungs remove carbon dioxide, a waste product of respiration, and take in oxygen, keeping their levels in the blood steady. The kidneys remove urea (from excess protein) and control the amount of water and salts in the blood by filtering and then reabsorbing what the body needs. Together they excrete wastes and maintain balance (homeostasis).
